headlines.text: On this day in 2025, the AEW TNT Title found a new home as Kyle Fletcher vs. Dustin Rhodes battled it out in a Chicago Street Fight match, appearing on Collision, rated 8.73 ? an outstanding performance from both sides ? ending the champion's reign at 2 defenses. In a bloody Chicago Street Fight filled with thumbtacks and a low blow, Fletcher dethroned Rhodes for the TNT Championship.
It was 2025 when Bandido & King was no more, reborn as Brodido after 2 matches, on Collision.
Rewind to 2025, when Scorpio Sky was back in action after a long-awaited stretch away after just under 2 years away, appearing on Collision.

secondaries.text: Back on this day in 2025, FTR vs. A.Gunn & Robinson locked horns for the first time on Collision, rated 7.50 ? a good, competitive contest.
Looking back to 2025, when Thekla vs. Willow Nightingale crossed paths for the first time ever on Collision, rated 6.65.
